selection.objective: Both semantic and forced-lexical calibration gates, worst classification rate, total classification rates, expected hit@3, labeled precision@3. Equal metrics favor the stricter lexical boundary, then the least restrictive semantic boundary within (0,1]. Held-out labels never select thresholds.

precisionDefinition: Mean precision among returned top-three titles for supported cases with explicit acceptable-title labels. Labels are not exhaustive culinary judgments; unlabeled titles count as a penalty. Broad queries are excluded.
